description: Agent Energy: submit one charging session, its posted price and what was charged: the posted price with the station, network, price per kWh, price per minute and whether it runs while charging or while connected, the session fee, the idle fee per minute and its grace minutes, the tax rate, currency, when it was posted and the price as shown; the session with its id, when charging started and stopped, when the vehicle was unplugged, the energy delivered in kWh and its currency; the charges for energy, time, the session fee, idle, tax, any other charge and the total; and optionally the tolerance (0.01 when left out). The signed report gives the session with its charging, connected and idle minutes, each charge beside the posted price times the session’s record as matches, overstated, understated, unposted, within_grace, not_charged or unread with the basis of each, the totals charged, summed and recomputed, and counts them, and names an overstated session: a charge above its recomputed amount, a charge with no posted price, an idle fee inside the grace period and a total above its lines; then a charge below the posted price and a total below its lines, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. Missing energy or times, no total, no posted price and a currency that differs leave the session unverified. This recomputes one session from its posted price: a fee schedule against a general quote or invoice is wever_fee-evidence-check, fees charged against a stated schedule over many transactions are wever_fee-reconciliation-check and the home rate plan a charger runs on is wever_energy-tariff-check. Verdict energy_charging_overstated, energy_charging_partial, energy_charging_unverified or energy_charging_accurate. POST /api/energy-ev-charging-check. Reads the energy records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Energy reads an energy customer’s own records and recomputes what they claim: the rate plan billed against the plan quoted, a solar or PPA proposal’s production and savings against its stated assumptions, a supply contract against what was agreed, a charging session against the posted price, a carbon credit or certificate claim against its retirement records, a utility bill against its tariff and usage, a commercial demand charge against interval usage and the tariff’s demand rules, and an equipment efficiency or savings claim against its rating and baseline. Beside it, wever_invoice-check reads any invoice against the job it belongs to and wever_fee-evidence-check a fee schedule against a quote or invoice, while an energy check recomputes energy charges from rates, usage and the tariff’s own rules; wever_contract-diff-check compares two versions of one text, while the contract check reads the signed contract against what was agreed; and wever_environmental-evidence-check reads sustainability claims against offered evidence, while the carbon claim check reads the retirement records behind one claim. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-energy-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-energy/.
